headline: Bank of America (BAC) Signals OCC Penalties Over Anti Money Laundering Deficiencies
summary: Bank of America (NYSE:BAC) disclosed that it may face monetary penalties tied to deficiencies in its anti money laundering program. The bank indicated that a resolution with the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency, or OCC, could be near. This disclosure marks a change from earlier statements that suggested any regulatory outcome was not expected to have a material financial impact. headline: Swift Announces Step Forward in International Money Transfers for Consumers in the US with Bank of America and J.P. Morgan Among First to Go Live
summary: NEW YORK, August 05, 2026--Individuals and small businesses receiving money from family, friends or businesses abroad will get a faster, clearer experience as Bank of America and J.P. Morgan go live with a new initiative from Swift, the organisation behind the global network that connects more than 11,500 financial institutions in over 200 countries and territories.
